cues.en: It's again time to apply what we learned about stores in our course project.
There thus far, if we have a quick look, we are managing all our data in the app svelte file, all
our meetup related data, I should say it's getting managed there and unlike in the store example of
the last course section here, we pretty much only have meetup data and we only have the meetup feature
In the last course section we had products in our cart which were loosely related.
Here we only have meetups, but this does not mean that a store wouldn't make sense.
A store can still save us some extra work where we pass data around through props and events across
multiple levels and it can also still lead to a leaner app svelte file where we are already accumulating
quite a lot of logic related to our meetups and that is something we might be able to change with the
Let's move forward and let's make sure that we actually use a store here in this project too.
And whilst we're on it, we'll actually also add a couple of new features to this application.
